title: Step-1 blocks submission when industry or size is left blank
description: step-1/page.jsx's next() handler checks '!form.industry || !form.size' and sets err='Please fill in both fields.' before calling completeStep.
steps: On /onboarding/step-1, leave 'Company size' unselected and click Continue
expectedResult: The form does not submit; 'Please fill in both fields.' is shown in red and the user remains on step-1.

title: Step-4 rejects a malformed email address before adding it to the invite list
description: isValidEmail() in step-4/page.jsx uses /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ to gate addEmail().
expectedResult: 'Enter a valid email address.' is displayed; the malformed value is not added as a Tag.

title: Step-4 enforces the 19-invite maximum
description: MAX_INVITES = 19 in step-4/page.jsx (owner already counts as the 20th seat toward the Growth-tier cap).
preconditions: 19 valid, unique emails already added to the invite list
steps: Attempt to add a 20th valid email
expectedResult: 'Maximum 19 invites.' is shown and the 20th email is not added to the Tag list.

title: Step-2 framework picker allows continuing with zero frameworks selected
description: Unlike step-1, Step2Page's next() handler has no guard on selected.length — it calls completeStep('step-2', { frameworks: [] }) even if nothing was checked.
steps: On /onboarding/step-2, select no frameworks and click Continue
expectedResult: The step completes and the wizard advances to /onboarding/step-3 with no client-side validation error, confirming framework selection is optional at this step.

title: Completing with an invalid step key leaves completedSteps untouched
expectedResult: The complete call returns 400 INVALID_STEP; GET /state shows completedSteps identical to before the call.

title: Both the Connect and Skip actions on step-3 ultimately mark step-3 complete
description: step-3/page.jsx has two paths to completion: markComplete() (direct 'Skip for now') and connectAndContinue() (redirects to /cloud-posture?onboarding=true&returnTo=/onboarding/step-3/return, with the actual completeStep call happening on return). Both must result in step-3 being present in completedSteps.
steps: Path A: click 'Skip for now' on step-3 and check completedSteps
Path B (separate org): click 'Connect AWS / Azure / GCP', complete the redirect flow, and check completedSteps
expectedResult: In both paths, 'step-3' appears in completedSteps and the wizard proceeds to step-4 — skipping is not a dead end that leaves step-3 perpetually incomplete.
